designs.title: Pisa
designs.why: Clean, well-drawn line art: the arcades, the bell chamber and the perforated stamp edge all hold up at full size, and the 3.97° denomination (the tower's actual lean) is a smart insider joke. But it reads like museum-shop clip art, not a brand graphic. It is all thin outline in an empty white frame, so from 3 m the tower turns into a gray hatch and the stamp has no weight or attitude. The small back placement makes it feel timid on both tees.
designs.fix: Flood the sky inside the frame with solid ink and knock the tower and the PISA header out of it (a reversed panel), so the stamp becomes a bold block with real contrast that reads from across the street. Keep the 3.97° wink.
